rubric_items.reason: All 13 acceptance criteria (S-1/AC1-4, S-2/AC1-4, S-3/AC1-4, S-4/AC1) are mapped to at least one test, and every one exists in split.md. TP-10 and TP-12 are clearly marked as still to write.

Rendering and formatting are tested with jsdom unit tests. Query rules (status, latest, paging, search, order, keys) are tested with Supertest integration tests. There is no e2e or manual testing, so each test is at the cheapest level that proves it.

There are negative tests for the changed endpoint (TP-15 invalid filter, TP-16 only-Cancelled with no cross-patient leak) and boundaries (TP-3 UTC/Kolkata date edge, TP-10 more than 20 rows, null fallback). No test covers two Completed visits with the same start.

The plan matches the strategy's tools (Vitest/Supertest/PostgreSQL, jsdom/Testing Library) and folders, and flags the DB-skip risk in Q-01. TP-14 maps to a test named PAT-8 rather than one starting with its requirement ID.

The titles are clear and a tester can run them. However, several planned TP titles do not match the real test names: TP-3/TP-4 and TP-5/6/7 are each one combined test, so a tester cannot find them by title.
